purpose: Role-family calibration for Platform and DevEx leadership searches.

cases.title: Director, Silicon Logical Design
cases.description: Lead silicon logical design and platform engineering for AI accelerators.
cases.rationale: Silicon design is not software platform leadership.

cases.title: Director, ASIC Design
cases.description: Lead ASIC design, developer tooling, and platform delivery.
cases.rationale: ASIC design is not software platform leadership.

cases.title: Director, Semiconductor Engineering
cases.description: Lead semiconductor engineering and cloud platform operations.
cases.rationale: Semiconductor engineering is not software platform leadership.

cases.title: Director, Hardware Architecture
cases.description: Lead hardware architecture and AI platform development.
cases.rationale: Hardware architecture is not software platform leadership.

cases.title: Director, Revenue Systems
cases.description: Lead revenue systems, platform engineering, and developer productivity.
cases.rationale: Revenue systems are not a software platform target family.

cases.title: Senior Director, Sales Systems
cases.description: Lead sales systems, cloud platform, and engineering productivity.
cases.rationale: Sales systems are not a software platform target family.

cases.title: Director, GTM Systems
cases.description: Lead GTM systems and internal developer platform tooling.
cases.rationale: GTM systems are not a software platform target family.

cases.title: Director, CRM Systems
cases.description: Lead CRM systems, platform engineering, and cloud operations.
cases.rationale: CRM systems are not a software platform target family.

cases.title: Director, Business Systems
cases.description: Lead business systems, developer tools, and platform operations.
cases.rationale: Business systems are not a software platform target family.

cases.title: Director of Engineering, Data
cases.description: Lead data platform engineering, data infrastructure, and data governance.
cases.rationale: Generic data leadership does not establish a Platform or DevEx role family.

cases.title: Director, Data Platform
cases.description: Lead data platform engineering, developer tooling, and self-service data services.
cases.rationale: Explicit data-platform leadership is eligible adjacent work, not a direct Platform or DevEx function match.

cases.title: Director, Data Infrastructure
cases.description: Lead data infrastructure, data platform engineering, and self-service services.
cases.rationale: Explicit data infrastructure is eligible adjacent work, not a direct Platform or DevEx function match.

cases.title: Director, ML Platform
cases.description: Lead ML platform services, machine learning infrastructure, and developer tooling.
cases.rationale: Explicit ML platform leadership is eligible adjacent work, not a direct Platform or DevEx function match.

cases.title: Director, Cloud & Reliability
cases.description: Lead cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, internal platform, and production operations.
cases.rationale: Cloud and reliability leadership with explicit internal-platform ownership is a viable target technical family.

cases.title: Director, SRE
cases.description: Lead site reliability engineering, incident response, cloud operations, and internal platform reliability.
cases.rationale: SRE leadership with explicit internal-platform ownership is a viable target technical family.

cases.title: Director, Production Engineering
cases.description: Lead production engineering, incident response, and operational readiness.
cases.rationale: Production engineering is adjacent without an explicit target platform family signal.

cases.title: Senior Director, Platform Engineering
cases.description: Lead platform engineering, developer experience, developer productivity, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and self-service platform teams.
cases.rationale: Direct executive platform leadership is the core target family.

cases.title: Director, Developer Experience
cases.description: Lead developer experience, developer platform, developer productivity, CI/CD, and self-service tooling.
cases.rationale: Direct DevEx leadership is a core target family.

cases.title: Director, AI Platform
cases.description: Lead AI platform, developer platform, cloud infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling teams.
cases.rationale: AI platform leadership is a direct target family when the title establishes platform ownership.
